scope: Read-only diagnosis on64 selected v11 TRAIN families,128enrollments; not a heldout accuracy estimate

loss_weight_accounting.caveat: BCE dilution alone is not the explanation: the separately weighted paired margin directly targets the fine distinction.

interpretation_limits: Relative feature energy and cosine distances are descriptive, not comparable information-capacity units.
Support/query mismatch combines pose, scale, color/background, and slight macro-instance jitter; not an isolated nuisance intervention.
Candidate ground-truth boxes and pose metadata are used only in this diagnosis.
A learned128D projection can suppress an input distinction without implying all downstream compression is harmful.
Frozen training-set measurements cannot establish generalization or performance on the fresh cohort.
